settings.title: How to Choose The Right Entrance Mat?
How Do I Choose the Right Entrance Mat for My Home or Business?

settings.text:
Choosing the right entrance mat is essential to keeping your space clean, safe, and welcoming.

Whether you're looking for an economical solution for moderate foot traffic or a premium option for high-end commercial spaces, there are key factors to consider such as material, durability, and cost-effectiveness.

In this guide, we break down the different categories of entrance mats, helping you find the perfect fit for your needs.

settings.subtitle: Best for Indoor and Outdoor
settings.title: CM Viper Rib
settings.text:
This mat features looped dual fibers in a ribbed pattern to absorb moisture and scrape away dirt.

The durable vinyl backing ensures it stays in place, making it a practical option for both indoor and outdoor use in moderate-traffic areas.

The CM Viper Rib is perfect for retail entrances looking for a cost-effective way to maintain clean and dry floors.

settings.subtitle: Great for Indoors
settings.title: Viper 2000 Poly plush
settings.text:
A low-profile entrance mat made from tufted yarns with a PVC vinyl backing, the Viper 2000 is great for indoor use.

It’s soft, durable, and hides dirt effectively, making it a budget-friendly option for low to moderate foot traffic.

settings.subtitle: Perfect for indoor & Outdoor
settings.title: Needle pin
settings.text:
Designed with looped dual fibers and a durable vinyl backing, the Viper 2500 Needle Pin is perfect for indoor and outdoor spaces.

It effectively absorbs moisture and scrapes away dirt, while its non-slip backing ensures safety in areas with moderate traffic.

settings.subtitle: GOOD VALUE MAT
settings.title: DURA NOP
settings.text:
A mat that gives you the best of both worlds.

It can be used both indoor and outdoor with its omni-directional nylon pattern that is mildew resistant and absorbs moisture.

settings.subtitle: Durability & functionality in 1 mat
settings.title: DURA NOP
settings.text:
Known for its durability and excellent moisture absorption, the Dura Nop Entrance Mat is ideal for moderate to high-traffic areas.

It features a blend of synthetic fibers and a composite rubber backing, making it perfect for protecting floors in both indoor and outdoor spaces. Its mildew resistance and berber pattern allow it to trap dirt and moisture while keeping your entrance looking tidy.

This mat is a popular choice across Canada for its reliability and low maintenance needs.

settings.title: CM Viper 9200

With a low-profile design and a looped dual-fiber construction, the CM Viper 9200 is ideal for commercial entrances, hallways, and lobbies.

Available in multiple colors, it easily blends with any décor while maintaining its functionality.

settings.title: Ultra Tuft
settings.text:
Perfect for those seeking the ultimate in luxury and performance

Great for secondary entrances in high-end commercial spaces

Made from premium nylon fibers, it offers a soft, comfortable underfoot feel while wicking away moisture and trapping dirt. Perfect for secondary entrances in high-end commercial spaces, the Ultra Tuft mat is both functional and elegant, ensuring a clean and dry entrance while adding a touch of sophistication.

settings.code:
What’s the Difference Between Economical Mats and Good Value Mat?

When selecting an entrance mat for your home or business, the range of options can seem overwhelming. From cost-effective solutions to high-end products, it's important to know which type of mat fits your needs.

In this guide, we’ll break down the key differences between economical mats and good value entrance mat to help you make an informed decision.

settings.subtitle: Economical Mats
settings.text:
Economical mats offer a practical solution for businesses and homes that need to maintain clean and safe floors at a lower cost. These mats are ideal for areas with low to moderate foot traffic, providing effective dirt and moisture control without the hefty price tag.

CM Viper Rib: A durable, looped-fiber mat that features a ribbed pattern for scraping away dirt and absorbing moisture. The CM Viper Rib is an excellent choice for indoor and outdoor use in retail entrances or moderate-traffic areas. Its low cost and vinyl backing make it a long-lasting, affordable option for commercial spaces.

Viper 2000 Poly-Plush: This economical mat is constructed with tufted yarns and a PVC vinyl backing, making it perfect for indoor environments with low to moderate foot traffic. It traps dirt and moisture effectively, hiding grime to keep entrances looking tidy throughout the day. Its low-profile design also allows for easy foot and cart transitions, making it a practical, low-cost option.

Viper 2500 Needle Pin: Made from looped synthetic fibers, the Needle Pin mat is designed to absorb moisture and scrape dirt, offering great value for moderate-traffic areas. Its vinyl backing prevents slips and floor damage, making it ideal for retail and office entrances where a cost-effective solution is required.

Choose economical mats if you are looking for excellent basic protection for floors at a low price point. They are best suited for moderate-traffic areas that need a budget-friendly solution to maintain cleanliness and prevent accidents.

settings.subtitle: Good Value Mat - Dura Nop
settings.text:
A Good value mat strike the perfect balance between affordability and durability. Dura Nop is specifically designed for areas with moderate to high traffic, offering long-lasting protection and superior dirt-trapping capabilities.

With its blended synthetic fibers and composite rubber backing, the Dura Nop mat is perfect for indoor and outdoor spaces that experience moderate to high foot traffic.

It traps up to 80% of dirt and moisture, protecting floors from wear and tear. The mildew-resistant properties and easy maintenance make it a favorite for commercial entranceways, offering exceptional performance for its price.

Pick Dura Nop for your business or home that need a step up in durability. This mat offer great functionality and longevity at a reasonable price, making them a great investment for high-traffic areas.

settings.title: What do I need to look for in premium entrance mats?
settings.text:
Key Features That Make a Premium Entrance Mat Stand Out

Premium entrance mats are designed for heavy traffic areas and combine superior performance with aesthetic appeal. These mats not only protect floors from dirt and moisture but also enhance the overall look of high-end commercial spaces.

CM Viper 8950: This mat is constructed with looped dual fibers that efficiently scrape debris and absorb moisture. Its non-slip backing ensures safety in heavy traffic areas like hotel lobbies and commercial entrances. The CM Viper 8950 mat is built to last and adds a touch of luxury to any space with its upscale design.

CM Viper 8925: For areas where appearance matters as much as performance, the CM Viper 8925 offers the perfect solution. Its random tufted pattern makes dirt virtually invisible, while its durable vinyl backing ensures that moisture doesn’t seep through to the floor with its high moisture absorption rate. This mat is a great choice for high-end foyers and commercial spaces where maintaining a clean, elegant environment is essential.

CM Viper 9200: Known for its durability and low-profile design, the CM Viper 9200 mat efficiently scrapes away dirt while blending seamlessly with commercial interiors. It is available in multiple colors to fit any decor and is perfect for high-traffic areas like elevators, hallways, and entrances.

Ultra Tuft: This premium mat combines functionality with a luxurious feel underfoot. The Ultra Tuft mat is designed with nylon fibers that wick away moisture, making it ideal for secondary entrances in high-end commercial spaces. Its soft texture and low profile make it both practical and aesthetically pleasing.
